web-guide-idea-42.audience: Beginner developers who need help understanding a bug.
web-guide-idea-42.offer: Offer a collaborative debugging session where the learner sees your process. Narrow the issue beforehand so the time is useful.
web-guide-idea-42.steps.0: Ask for a minimal example without secrets.
web-guide-idea-42.steps.1: Reproduce the issue and inspect assumptions together.
web-guide-idea-42.steps.2: Explain the fix and how to recognise a similar problem later.
web-guide-idea-42.equipment: A computer with the coding environment is normally needed, plus a phone or webcam for conversation. Never request production passwords.
web-guide-idea-42.returnReason: Follow-up sessions can tackle a new concept or review the learner’s own fix.
web-guide-idea-42.promotion: Share a small fictional debugging example and list the languages or frameworks you know.
web-guide-idea-42.metadataTitle: Coding Debug Buddy — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · avaTOK
web-guide-idea-42.metadataDescription: Work through a coding problem together and explain how you find and fix the issue. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
